articles.title: The war with Iran may be ushering in a new nuclear age
articles.summary: Donald Trump's assertive stance towards adversaries and allies is raising global concerns about a potential new nuclear age. This approach is prompting governments worldwide to re-evaluate their nuclear strategies and defence policies. SSB aspirants should note the profound implications for international security and arms control, signaling a shifting geopolitical landscape with increased proliferation risks.

articles.title: Koshering the kitchen for Passover
articles.summary: The article details the meticulous process of cleaning kitchens for Pesach (Passover), emphasizing the thorough removal of every small crumb of chametz (leavened food). This religious observance requires greater care than general house cleaning to ensure strict adherence to traditions for the Jewish holiday, highlighting specific cultural and religious practices within a nation.

articles.title: [Catholic Caucus Devotional] My Catholic Life! Catholic Daily Reflections: Palm Sunday—A Model of Courage and Determination - Sunday, March 29, 2026
articles.summary: A significant religious commemoration is underway, recalling the biblical account of Jesus' entry into Jerusalem as described in Matthew 21:10-11. The event, where crowds identified Jesus as a prophet from Nazareth, describes the city being 'shaken'. This pivotal historical moment is annually observed by numerous communities worldwide, marking a key religious observance.

articles.title: 134 Irishmen killed at sea added to official roll of second World War fatalities
articles.summary: The Commonwealth War Graves Commission (CWGC) has officially added 134 Irish merchant navy and fishing fleet seamen to the roll of those who died in the Second World War. This significant update honors individuals previously unacknowledged, ensuring their sacrifice for Allied efforts during the conflict is remembered and properly recorded, highlighting international remembrance initiatives.

articles.title: Barnes and Noble NOOK Glowlight 4 Ocean Teal Review
articles.summary: Barnes & Noble is employing an unusual strategy to boost sales of its NOOK e-readers: releasing limited-edition colors. Unlike many e-reader brands, this approach aims to generate excitement and drive purchases, with the NOOK Glowlight 4 Pearl Pink edition being an early example. This innovative marketing tactic highlights their efforts to stand out in the competitive consumer electronics market.

articles.title: ‘Malcolm In The Middle’ Team On The Possibility Of A Full-Fledged Reboot: “A Whole New Set Of Characters And Circumstances That Are Ripe”
articles.summary: The popular sitcom "Malcolm in the Middle" is reportedly eyeing a revival, with a highly anticipated four-part installment planned for Disney+/Hulu. While initial plans point to a limited series, the show's creators and team have not ruled out the possibility of a full-fledged reboot. This news signals a potential return for the beloved series on major streaming platforms, engaging a global audience.

articles.title: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey wants to arm the U.S.’s allies. Could his insistence on deferring to Washington scare them off?
articles.summary: Palmer Luckey, founder of the defense-technology startup Anduril, controversially stated he would sell weapons to North Korea if directed by the U.S. government. Luckey, who founded Anduril in 2017 after his politically charged exit from Oculus VR, emphasizes his company's adherence to government directives. This position highlights complex ethical considerations in defense contracting and the role of private tech firms in national security decisions.

articles.title: agent-cafe added to PyPI
articles.summary: Agent Café introduces an innovative agent-to-agent (A2A) marketplace where AI agents can independently post jobs, bid on tasks, deliver results, and receive payment. This platform facilitates autonomous collaboration and work processes among AI entities. Connecting an AI agent is designed to be straightforward, requiring minimal code. It represents a significant step in the evolving digital economy powered by artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Adani delivers 2,000 Prahar LMGs to Army
articles.summary: Adani Defence & Aerospace flagged off the initial 2,000 Prahar 7.62x51 mm Light Machine Guns from its Gwalior facility to the Indian Army. This delivery marks the beginning of a larger contract for 41,000 indigenously manufactured LMGs, significantly boosting the Army's capabilities and reinforcing India's self-reliance in defence production, crucial for national security.
